decision: one PR, one commit per source issue
choice: build all seven criteria on PR #734 in the plan's order, one commit per source issue
why: Max's answers comment approved the plan as one PR to keep review handoffs down

choice: skip _abandon_closed while the PR's branch is at base and a non-Grok job for the ticket is running
why: _abandon_closed has three callers (comments.py twice, core.py through the merge-queue fresh read); guarding one comments.py caller still abandoned the ticket through core.py

choice: reuse handoff_check.retrying for the factory.md read, opt-in through retry_log, passed only by the waiter's pre-ready check
why: one retry policy for every pre-ready read; the brief path and orch job done keep their single read. retrying gained a label argument so the log line says factory.md read

choice: the replan records handoff-unverified on the superseded plan job when it has no verify event
why: _verify_handoffs selects unaudited done jobs later in the same poll, so clearing attention alone was undone; cli lost_plan matches only the "is not on the ticket" detail, so the new detail does not trip it

decision: #603 f-1 queued jobs on a rebound ticket
choice: rewrite pr_number and post_to on queued head-less non-Grok jobs; cancel queued head-bound jobs with rebound:<old>-><new>; leave Grok jobs
why: cancelling every job stalls the ticket because the dedupe key blocks the go from queueing the build again; a head belongs to the old PR, so head-bound jobs cannot be rewritten

choice: clear ticket_sources.pr_number when the ticket has no PR
why: _factory_pr_number raises on gh errors, so None means the ticket really has no PR

choice: snapshot the accepted plan text at the over-size park in ticket_state.paused_plan_text, prefer it on resume, fall back to the comment for older rows
why: the size park stored only the comment id, so resume reread mutable text; the questions park that can pause a build writes NULL so an old snapshot cannot leak

choice: bound lines= and round= to nine digits in the header grammar
why: the dispatcher then ignores the header before the plan-check transaction, and orch job done refuses it so the builder can repost; a parser bound is one line instead of new size handling

choice: BEGIN IMMEDIATE before the verdict_acceptances existence check, commit after the backfill
why: the default isolation level autocommitted the CREATE, so an interruption left an empty table that later starts never backfilled; same pattern as the ticket_state migration

choice: no code change: already fixed on main by #701 (c0b5abb0)
why: the names_the_repo tests pass on main (5 passed) and 4 of them fail with #701's lib diff reverted
